description: By Christopher Gangemi January 15, 2026 It’s been over a decade since a Democrat held the First Congressional District, and over the last two decades most candidates (minus Nancy Goroff in 2020) have hailed from the East End. Perry Gershon of East Hampton won 47.4 percent of the vote in 2018…
